stem: A weekly KPI worsens, but the data set contains two missing shifts and one sensor outage. What is the strongest Technician II interpretation?
choices: Declare the process out of control immediately
Flag the apparent trend while documenting missingness and data-quality limitations before making a high-confidence process conclusion
Replace missing values with the best-performing shift
rationale: Operational metrics must be interpreted with data completeness and measurement quality. Technician II should preserve the signal and the uncertainty rather than hide missingness or overstate confidence.
